### Executive Summary
The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), and Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) have issued a joint warning regarding Medusa ransomware activity. 

According to the advisory reported by CPO Magazine, the Medusa ransomware threat actors have impacted and targeted over 500 critical infrastructure organizations across multiple sectors.

The specific root cause, initial access vectors, and technical execution mechanisms leveraged in these Medusa ransomware attacks are not yet confirmed in the available source text.

Organizations targeted by Medusa ransomware face significant operational disruption, risk of sensitive data exfiltration, and compromise of critical services across affected infrastructure environments.
